name: Oxylabs Web Scraper API
summary: Oxylabs Web Scraper API (Classic): scrape any URL, Google results and Amazon products as HTML, Markdown or parsed JSON, live or as async jobs.

username.description: The API user name created for Web Scraper API in the dashboard (not your dashboard login).

notes: Every scrape is POST /v1/queries with a source naming the scraper (universal, google_search, amazon_product, ...). This entry names three; others take the same shape.
Realtime calls (on realtime.oxylabs.io) hold the connection until the result is ready. Push-pull (jobs.create on data.oxylabs.io) returns a job id: poll jobs.status until done, then jobs.results.

This is the Classic API with HTTP Basic credentials, the one the library's extract backend uses. Oxylabs' newer Web API (webapi.oxylabs.io, Bearer OXYLABS_WEB_API_KEY) is a separate product and not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Scrape a URL
endpoints.summary: Any public page as HTML, Markdown or parsed data, returned in the same call.

render.description: html renders JavaScript (try it when content comes back empty).

markdown.description: Return the page as Markdown instead of HTML. Default false.

parse.description: Return parsed JSON where a dedicated parser exists. Default false.

parsing_instructions.description: Custom parsing logic run on the HTML result.

geo_location.description: Location to fetch from, e.g. 'United States' or a city or postal code; see the proxy-location page for formats.

user_agent_type.description: Device type and browser. Default desktop.

browser_instructions.description: Browser actions to run while rendering.

context.description: List of {key, value} pairs: headers, cookies, session_id, http_method, content, follow_redirects, successful_status_codes (and limit_per_page for Google).

notes: A read over POST. Set markdown true for LLM-ready text.

endpoints.name: Search Google
endpoints.summary: Google web results for a query, raw or parsed, returned in the same call.

parse.description: Return parsed JSON where a dedicated parser exists. Default false.

render.description: html renders JavaScript (try it when content comes back empty).

geo_location.description: Location to fetch from, e.g. 'United States' or a city or postal code; see the proxy-location page for formats.

locale.description: Accept-Language for the Google interface language.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 10; Google now gives about 10 organic results a page.

user_agent_type.description: Device type and browser. Default desktop.

context.description: List of {key, value} pairs: headers, cookies, session_id, http_method, content, follow_redirects, successful_status_codes (and limit_per_page for Google).

notes: A read over POST. geo_location matters a lot for Google results.

endpoints.name: Get an Amazon product
endpoints.summary: An Amazon product page by ASIN, parsed into price, buybox, rating and more.

parse.description: Return parsed JSON where a dedicated parser exists. Default false.

domain.description: Amazon domain suffix, e.g. com, nl, de.

geo_location.description: Delivery location, e.g. a postal code.

render.description: html renders JavaScript (try it when content comes back empty).

user_agent_type.description: Device type and browser. Default desktop.

context.description: List of {key, value} pairs: headers, cookies, session_id, http_method, content, follow_redirects, successful_status_codes (and limit_per_page for Google).

endpoints.name: Submit an async scrape job
endpoints.summary: Queue a universal scrape and get a job id (push-pull).

render.description: html renders JavaScript (try it when content comes back empty).

markdown.description: Return the page as Markdown instead of HTML. Default false.

parse.description: Return parsed JSON where a dedicated parser exists. Default false.

parsing_instructions.description: Custom parsing logic run on the HTML result.

geo_location.description: Location to fetch from, e.g. 'United States' or a city or postal code; see the proxy-location page for formats.

user_agent_type.description: Device type and browser. Default desktop.

browser_instructions.description: Browser actions to run while rendering.

context.description: List of {key, value} pairs: headers, cookies, session_id, http_method, content, follow_redirects, successful_status_codes (and limit_per_page for Google).

callback_url.description: URL Oxylabs POSTs to when the job finishes.

notes: A read over POST that starts a billed job. Any other source and its parameters work here too, through a raw call.

endpoints.name: Get job status
endpoints.summary: A push-pull job's status: pending, done or faulted.

endpoints.name: Get job results
endpoints.summary: A finished job's content, raw, parsed, png or xhr.

type.description: Result type; omit for the default.

notes: The _links in job answers use http://; always call over https.
